MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 1

2. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 37
   C. 31.7
   D. 31

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

4. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 5
   C. 8
   D. 4

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 1
   C. 5
   D. 7

6. Solve for x: x + 3 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 9
   C. 10
   D. 12

7. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

8. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 4

9. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 16
   C. 0
   D. 64

10. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 121
   C. 11
   D. 122

11. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

12. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

13. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 82
   C. 81
   D. 18

14. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

15. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 7

16. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 170

17. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

18. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 14

19. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19.6
   C. 19
   D. 25

20. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 24

21. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 25

22. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 33
   C. 27.7
   D. 27

23. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.7
   C. 23
   D. 23.6

24. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 42
